title: Data Engineer
description:
Data Engineer

£75,000 - £95,000 + Benefits
London (Hybrid)

This is a great opportunity to join a high-growth, technology-driven organisation undergoing a major cloud and data transformation. You'll play a key role in building a brand-new GCP analytics platform from the ground up, helping shape the future of data across the business.

THE COMPANY:

This organisation operates within a specialist, highly regulated industry and has built a strong reputation through its innovative use of technology, data and analytics. Backed by significant investment and continued growth, the business is making major investments in its modern data platform and cloud capabilities.

With a collaborative culture, strong employee retention and a focus on continuous improvement, this is an environment where engineers can take ownership, solve meaningful problems and directly influence business outcomes.

THE ROLE:

You will take ownership of building and developing a new GCP Data Analytics Platform while helping modernise the organisation's wider data estate.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Building end-to-end data solutions, from ingestion through to business-facing outputs.
  • Developing scalable ingestion pipelines using APIs, CDC, SFTP and streaming technologies.
  • Designing and optimising dbt transformation layers and warehouse workflows.
  • Creating dimensional models, fact tables and star schema designs to support analytics at scale.
YOUR SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

You will bring strong capability in:

  • Hands-on GCP experience in a commercial environment.
  • Strong expertise with dbt
  • Advanced dimensional modelling skills
  • Strong Python and SQL experience
  • Experience with Terraform, Kafka, Dataflow or Pub/Sub.
THE BENEFITS:

You will receive a salary of £75,000 - £95,000 depending on experience.

HOW TO APPLY:

Please register your interest by sending your CV to Molly Bird via the apply link on this page.
